structured.reason: an alert is firing on a production service
structured.summary: checkout cannot acquire a database connection

entries.text: Both database instances are available [e1], so nothing is down. The reporting job opened 96 of the 100 connections against the checkout database at 12:16 [e2], four minutes before the alert. The Multi-AZ failover completed at 11:02 and the instance has been available since, so the failover is not the cause, and CPU is not saturated on either instance.

structured.root_cause: the reporting job holds 96 of the 100 connections in the checkout database's pool, so checkout cannot acquire one
structured.summary: Both instances are available [e1] and the reporting job took 96 of 100 connections at 12:16 [e2]. The earlier Multi-AZ failover completed cleanly at 11:02, and CPU is not the constraint — the pool is.
causal_chain: the checkout pool had four left
remediation_steps: give the reporting job its own connection pool with a hard cap
run the reporting job against the read replica
recommended_actions: give the reporting job its own connection pool with a hard cap
run the reporting job against the read replica
